# Kansas City Dumpster Rentals

> Locally owned roll-off dumpster rental serving the Greater Kansas City metro area. 13, 17, and 21-yard dumpsters. Same-day delivery available. Free driveway board protection on every delivery.

## About

Kansas City Dumpster Rentals is a locally owned and operated roll-off dumpster rental company serving a 35-mile radius across the Greater Kansas City metro area, covering both the Missouri and Kansas sides. The company offers 13, 17, and 21-yard dumpsters. All share the same 14x8 ft driveway footprint.

## Key differentiators

- Free wooden driveway board protection included on every delivery
- Same-day delivery available (subject to schedule)
- Tight-spot specialists: serves KC Midtown, Hyde Park, Westport, Brookside, Waldo, and other neighborhoods with narrow gangway driveways
- Locally owned, not a franchise
- Operates Mon-Sun, 8am-6pm Central Time

## Contact

- Phone: (404) 759-4361
- Email: kansascitydumpsters@gmail.com
- Service area: Greater Kansas City metro, 35-mile radius

## Sizes

| Size | Height | Length | Width | Best for |
|------|--------|--------|-------|----------|
| 13-yard | 4 ft | 14 ft | 8 ft | Small cleanouts, single-room renos, yard debris |
| 17-yard | 5 ft | 14 ft | 8 ft | Whole-home cleanouts, multi-room renos, estate cleanouts |
| 21-yard | 6 ft | 14 ft | 8 ft | Roofing, large construction, full property cleanouts |

## Key policies

- 7-day rental period included
- $20/day extension fee
- $75/ton overage weight fee
- Cancellation 24+ hrs: free; under 24 hrs: $50; after dispatch: $100
- Swap-out/dump-and-return: $200 flat
- Street/sidewalk permits: customer's responsibility (not provided by company)
- Outside service area (36-50 miles): $100 flat surcharge
